blocks.zh: 元件、組件系統與可萃取物
blocks.en: Components, Assemblies, Systems and Extractables

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 區分單次使用元件（Single-Use Components）、組件系統（SUS）三個層次的定義，掌握浸濕元件與非浸濕元件的分類邏輯
blocks.en: Distinguish the three levels of single-use components, assemblies and systems (SUS), and understand the classification logic for wetted and non-wetted components

blocks.zh: 熟悉主要單次使用元件的功能與特性——包括生物工藝袋、管路、連接器、過濾器、感測器、閥件等——以及它們在無菌充填流程中的應用場景
blocks.en: Become familiar with the functions and characteristics of the main single-use components (bioprocess bags, tubing, connectors, filters, sensors, valves, etc.) and how they are applied in the sterile filling process

blocks.zh: 理解可萃取物（Extractables）與可瀝出物（Leachables）的本質差異，掌握 E&L 研究在藥品安全評估中的核心地位
blocks.en: Understand the essential difference between Extractables and Leachables, and the central role of E&L studies in drug product safety assessment

blocks.zh: 掌握可萃取物研究的設計空間概念，包括 QbD 原則、臨界應用分層、PCM/PPC/CCS 的層級架構
blocks.en: Grasp the design space concept for extractables studies, including QbD principles, tiering by critical application, and the PCM/PPC/CCS hierarchy

blocks.zh: 了解可萃取物測試的方法論——模擬溶劑選擇、萃取參數設定、分析技術（GC-MS、LC-MS、ICP-MS）及 AET 接受標準判斷
blocks.en: Understand the methodology of extractables testing: model solvent selection, extraction parameter setting, analytical techniques (GC-MS, LC-MS, ICP-MS) and judging results against the AET acceptance criterion

blocks.zh: 建立 CDMO 視角的 E&L 風險管理思維：從供應商數據審查、責任矩陣分工到毒理評估結論的完整工作流程
blocks.en: Build a CDMO perspective on E&L risk management: the full workflow from reviewing supplier data and assigning responsibilities in a responsibility matrix to reaching a toxicological assessment conclusion

blocks.zh: 2.1 Single-Use Components, Assemblies, and Systems（單次使用元件、組件系統總覽）
blocks.en: 2.1 Single-Use Components, Assemblies, and Systems

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三層架構——元件 → 組件 → 系統
blocks.en: Core Concept: Three Levels (Component → Assembly → System)

blocks.zh: ISPE SUT 用清晰的三層分類架構來描述單次使用技術的範疇：
blocks.en: ISPE SUT uses a clear three-level classification to describe the scope of single-use technology:

blocks.zh: 元件 (Component)：最小單位，例如一截管路、一個連接器
blocks.en: Component: the smallest unit, for example a length of tubing or a connector

blocks.zh: 組件 (Assembly)：多個元件組合成一個製程操作單元，例如「過濾組件」= 過濾器 + 管路 + 連接器
blocks.en: Assembly: several components combined into one process operation unit, for example a "filtration assembly" = filter + tubing + connectors

blocks.zh: 系統 (SUS)：組件 + 多次使用設備（如不鏽鋼框架、泵浦驅動器）整合而成的完整設備
blocks.en: System (SUS): an assembly integrated with multi-use equipment (such as a stainless steel frame or pump drive) into a complete piece of equipment

blocks.zh: 這個三層架構對 E&L 研究非常重要——萃取研究通常從元件層次開始，再擴展到系統層次的浸出研究。
blocks.en: This three-level structure matters a great deal for E&L studies: extraction studies usually start at the component level and then extend to leaching studies at the system level.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把這三層想成蓋房子：元件 = 磚頭、鋼筋（個別材料）；組件 = 一堵牆、一個房間（功能單元）；系統 = 整棟建築（含水電設備的完整設施）。做材料安全測試時，先測磚頭的化學析出，再測整棟建築的室內空氣品質。
blocks.en: Think of the three levels as building a house: components = bricks and rebar (individual materials); assemblies = a wall or a room (functional units); systems = the whole building (a complete facility including plumbing and electrical services). In material safety testing, you first test the chemical release of the bricks, then the indoor air quality of the whole building.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的日常作業中，三個層次的管理責任不同：
blocks.en: In day-to-day CDMO operations, responsibility for managing the three levels differs:

blocks.zh: 元件：由供應商提供 CoA（成分証明）與 E&L 資料包
blocks.en: Component: the supplier provides the CoA (Certificate of Analysis) and the E&L data package

blocks.zh: 組件：通常由 CDMO 或供應商依 URS 客製化組裝，需進行完整性測試
blocks.en: Assembly: usually assembled to a custom design by the CDMO or the supplier according to the URS, and requires integrity testing

blocks.zh: 系統：CDMO 負責設備確效（IQ/OQ/PQ）及操作 SOP
blocks.en: System: the CDMO is responsible for equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) and operating SOPs

blocks.zh: 2.1.1 Single-Use Components（單次使用元件）
blocks.en: 2.1.1 Single-Use Components

blocks.zh: Bioprocess Bags（生物工藝袋）
blocks.en: Bioprocess Bags

blocks.zh: Bottles（瓶）
blocks.en: Bottles

blocks.zh: Impellers/Mixers（攪拌器）
blocks.en: Impellers/Mixers

blocks.zh: Tubing（管路）
blocks.en: Tubing

blocks.zh: Port Fittings（接口配件）
blocks.en: Port Fittings

blocks.zh: Connectors（連接器）
blocks.en: Connectors

blocks.zh: Disconnectors（斷開器）
blocks.en: Disconnectors

blocks.zh: Filter Capsules（過濾器）
blocks.en: Filter Capsules

blocks.zh: Valves（閥）
blocks.en: Valves

blocks.zh: Sensors（感測器）
blocks.en: Sensors

blocks.zh: Other Components（其他元件）
blocks.en: Other Components

blocks.zh: 核心概念：浸濕 vs 非浸濕元件
blocks.en: Core Concept: Wetted vs Non-Wetted Components

blocks.zh: 這個分類對 E&L 研究至關重要。浸濕元件（Wetted）直接接觸產品或製程液體，是潛在化學污染的來源，必須進行完整的可萃取物研究。非浸濕元件（Non-Wetted）如夾具、扣件，雖不直接接觸液體，但若透過浸濕元件間接傳遞，也需要評估。
blocks.en: This classification is critical for E&L studies. Wetted components contact the product or process fluid directly; they are a potential source of chemical contamination and must undergo a full extractables study. Non-wetted components such as clamps and fasteners do not touch the fluid directly, but if they can transfer substances indirectly through wetted components they also need to be assessed.

blocks.zh: 進一步，浸濕元件依接觸時間分層——靜態長時間接觸（如儲存袋）與動態短時間接觸（如生物反應器袋）的 E&L 風險截然不同，需採用不同的萃取條件。
blocks.en: Wetted components are further tiered by contact time: the E&L risks of static long-term contact (such as a storage bag) and dynamic short-term contact (such as a bioreactor bag) are quite different and call for different extraction conditions.

blocks.zh: 關鍵元件：生物工藝袋 (Bioprocess Bag)
blocks.en: Key Component: Bioprocess Bag

blocks.zh: 生物工藝袋是 SUT 中體積最大、E&L 最受關注的元件。幾個關鍵參數：
blocks.en: The bioprocess bag is the largest component in SUT by volume and the one that draws the most E&L attention. Several key parameters:

blocks.zh: 材質：多層聚合膜（通常含 LDPE、EVA 等），各層功能不同（阻隔層、強度層、接觸層）
blocks.en: Material: multilayer polymer film (usually containing LDPE, EVA, etc.), with each layer serving a different function (barrier layer, strength layer, contact layer)

blocks.zh: 2-D vs 3-D：30 mL–50 L 為 2-D 枕型；100 L–3,000 L 為 3-D 需不鏽鋼支撐框架
blocks.en: 2-D vs 3-D: 30 mL–50 L bags are 2-D pillow bags; 100 L–3,000 L bags are 3-D and need a stainless steel support frame

blocks.zh: 伽馬輻照：預滅菌處理，但輻照會改變聚合物化學特性，可能增加可萃取物——這是 E&L 研究的關鍵輸入
blocks.en: Gamma irradiation: a pre-sterilization treatment, but irradiation changes polymer chemistry and may increase extractables, so it is a key input to the E&L study

blocks.zh: 關鍵元件：管路 (Tubing)
blocks.en: Key Component: Tubing

blocks.zh: 管路是 SUT 中面積最廣的液體接觸元件，也是蠕動泵磨損的直接對象：
blocks.en: Tubing is the single-use component with the largest liquid contact area, and it is also the direct target of peristaltic pump wear:

blocks.zh: 矽膠管 (Silicone)：柔性好，生物相容性佳，蠕動泵首選，但有氧化矽浸出風險
blocks.en: Silicone: flexible and biocompatible, the first choice for peristaltic pumps, but carries a risk of leaching silicon oxides

blocks.zh: 氟聚合物管 (Fluoropolymer)：化學惰性強，適合高溶劑耐受需求，但較硬
blocks.en: Fluoropolymer: highly chemically inert and suited to demanding solvent resistance, but stiffer

blocks.zh: 熱塑性管 (Thermoplastic)：可熱封/熱焊接，實現無菌連接與斷開
blocks.en: Thermoplastic: can be heat-sealed or heat-welded, enabling sterile connection and disconnection

blocks.zh: 關鍵元件：無菌連接器 (Aseptic Connectors)
blocks.en: Key Component: Aseptic Connectors

blocks.zh: 無菌連接器是 SUT 的一大競爭性創新領域，關鍵區別：
blocks.en: Aseptic connectors are a highly competitive area of innovation in SUT. The key distinction:

blocks.zh: 無性別連接器 (Genderless)：任一件可與另一件配對，庫存管理簡單
blocks.en: Genderless: any half can mate with any other, which keeps inventory management simple

blocks.zh: 有性別連接器 (Gendered)：公/母配對，設計上能防止錯誤連接
blocks.en: Gendered: male/female pairing, designed to prevent incorrect connections

blocks.zh: 蒸汽原位連接器 (SIP)：用於 SUT 與傳統不鏽鋼系統的橋接點
blocks.en: Steam-in-place (SIP) connectors: used as the bridge between SUT and conventional stainless steel systems

blocks.zh: 重點提示：過濾器的關鍵分類
blocks.en: Key Notes: Key Classification of Filters

blocks.zh: 在無菌製程中，最關鍵的是除菌過濾（Sterilizing Grade），孔徑 ≤0.22 μm，需通過 ASTM F838 泡點測試與細菌截留測試驗證。
blocks.en: In aseptic processing, the most critical filter is the sterilizing-grade filter, with a pore size ≤0.22 μm, validated by the ASTM F838 bubble point test and bacterial retention test.

blocks.zh: 切向流過濾（TFF）用於超濾/濃縮製程，流路設計複雜，通常作為預設計組件提供，不適合臨時拼裝。
blocks.en: Tangential flow filtration (TFF) is used for ultrafiltration/concentration processes. Its flow path design is complex, so it is usually supplied as a pre-designed assembly and is not suitable for ad hoc assembly.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：感測器的單次 vs 多次選擇
blocks.en: Analogy: Single-Use vs Multi-Use Sensors

blocks.zh: 想像一次性快篩試劑（單次感測器）vs 實驗室分析儀（多次感測器）：快篩方便但精確度有限；分析儀精確但需要清潔校準。在 SUT 中，pH、溶氧等單次感測器的精度已大幅提升，但部分高精度應用（如濁度、UV 吸收）仍仰賴多次感測器透過無菌隔膜插入。
blocks.en: Compare a disposable rapid test kit (single-use sensor) with a laboratory analyzer (multi-use sensor): the rapid test is convenient but has limited accuracy, while the analyzer is accurate but needs cleaning and calibration. In SUT, the accuracy of single-use sensors for pH, dissolved oxygen and similar measurements has improved greatly, but some high-precision applications (such as turbidity and UV absorbance) still rely on multi-use sensors inserted through a sterile membrane.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：元件選型決策樹
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Component Selection Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 接新客戶 tech transfer 時，元件選型需考量：
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a new client's tech transfer, component selection should consider:

blocks.zh: 客戶原廠使用的品牌是否與我方供應商兼容？（連接器介面標準化）
blocks.en: Is the brand the client uses at its original site compatible with our suppliers? (standardization of connector interfaces)

blocks.zh: 產品接觸元件的 E&L 數據包是否符合 ICH Q3D 元素雜質、AET 要求？
blocks.en: Does the E&L data package for product-contact components meet ICH Q3D elemental impurity and AET requirements?

blocks.zh: 伽馬輻照劑量是否符合廠內驗收規格？（通常 25–45 kGy）
blocks.en: Does the gamma irradiation dose meet our site acceptance specification? (usually 25–45 kGy)

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵管路是否通過 pump tubing validation（磨損微粒測試）？
blocks.en: Has the peristaltic pump tubing passed pump tubing validation (particulate test for wear)?

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的充填工廠，哪些元件屬於「浸濕 + 長接觸時間」的高風險類別？供應商的 E&L 數據包是否涵蓋伽馬輻照後的條件？
blocks.en: In your filling plant, which components fall into the high-risk "wetted + long contact time" category? Does the supplier's E&L data package cover post-gamma-irradiation conditions?

blocks.zh: 你工廠現有的管路材質組合是什麼？有無混用矽膠管與熱塑性管的場景？連接點如何保持無菌？
blocks.en: What combination of tubing materials does your plant use today? Are there cases where silicone and thermoplastic tubing are mixed? How is sterility maintained at the connection points?

blocks.zh: 2.1.2 Single-Use Assemblies（單次使用組件）
blocks.en: 2.1.2 Single-Use Assemblies

blocks.zh: 核心概念：組件設計的標準化 vs 客製化取捨
blocks.en: Core Concept: Standardized vs Custom Assembly Design

blocks.zh: 選擇標準化組件的優勢：庫存品項少、可跨製程步驟共用、供應鏈穩定、E&L 數據已驗證。選擇客製化組件的場景：製程有特殊接口需求、客戶指定供應商、清洗/滅菌方式特殊。
blocks.en: Advantages of choosing standardized assemblies: fewer inventory items, reuse across process steps, a stable supply chain and already-validated E&L data. Situations that call for custom assemblies: the process has special interface requirements, the client specifies the supplier, or the cleaning/sterilization method is unusual.

blocks.zh: ISPE 指引的建議方向：能標準化就標準化——這也是 CDMO 降低 COGs（Cost of Goods）的關鍵策略之一。
blocks.en: The direction recommended by the ISPE guide: standardize wherever you can. This is also one of the key strategies for a CDMO to reduce COGs (Cost of Goods).

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念：管路岐管 (Manifold) 設計要點
blocks.en: Key Concept: Design Points for Tubing Manifolds

blocks.zh: Manifold 是多條流路匯集或分流的核心組件，設計不良會導致：
blocks.en: A manifold is the core assembly where multiple flow paths merge or split; poor design leads to:

blocks.zh: 死角 (Dead Leg)：流體停滯區域，微生物生長的溫床——管路長度不得超過管徑 6 倍原則
blocks.en: Dead legs: stagnant zones where fluid does not move and microorganisms can grow; the rule of thumb is that branch length must not exceed 6 times the tube diameter

blocks.zh: 壓力損失：彎頭過多或管徑驟縮導致壓降不符預期
blocks.en: Pressure loss: too many elbows or sudden narrowing of the bore cause a pressure drop different from what was expected

blocks.zh: 完整性風險：連接點過多，每個焊接點或連接器都是潛在洩漏點
blocks.en: Integrity risk: too many connection points; every weld or connector is a potential leak point

blocks.zh: 重點提示：充填組件的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Notes: What Makes Filling Assemblies Special

blocks.zh: 充填組件（Filling Assembly）是整個無菌製程中風險最高的組件，原因：
blocks.en: The filling assembly is the highest-risk assembly in the whole aseptic process, because:

blocks.zh: 距離最終產品最近，無任何後續稀釋或過濾步驟可降低風險
blocks.en: It is closest to the final product, with no later dilution or filtration step to reduce risk

blocks.zh: 微粒要求最嚴格——任何橡膠磨耗、矽膠粒子都可能成為注射用藥品的異物
blocks.en: Particulate requirements are the strictest: any rubber wear debris or silicone particles could become foreign matter in an injectable

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵管路需通過 pump wear validation，確認微粒脫落在可接受範圍
blocks.en: Peristaltic pump tubing must pass pump wear validation to confirm that particle shedding is within acceptable limits

blocks.zh: 這呼應了 2.2.4.3 節的「臨界應用分層」原則：充填步驟屬最高風險等級。
blocks.en: This echoes the "tiering by critical application" principle in Section 2.2.4.3: the filling step is in the highest risk class.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：混合組件的攪拌器選擇
blocks.en: Analogy: Choosing the Mixer for a Mixing Assembly

blocks.zh: 想像三種廚房攪拌方式：頂部安裝攪拌器（如家用桌上攪拌機）適合中等黏度、需要開口加料；底部安裝攪拌器（如咖啡機研磨）適合密閉系統、較均勻的流體；泵循環（Pump Around）（如魚缸過濾泵）適合大體積、輕柔混合怕剪力的生物製劑（如 mAb 原液）。選錯攪拌方式，蛋白質聚集就發生了。
blocks.en: Picture three kitchen mixing methods: a top-mounted mixer (like a household stand mixer) suits medium-viscosity fluids that need an open port for additions; a bottom-mounted mixer (like a coffee grinder) suits closed systems and more uniform fluids; pump-around (like an aquarium filter pump) suits large volumes and gentle mixing of shear-sensitive biologics (such as mAb drug substance). Choose the wrong mixing method and protein aggregation will occur.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：Filling Assembly 的風險管理
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Risk Management of the Filling Assembly

blocks.zh: 在一次性充填系統的驗證中，CDMO 的實務工作項目包括：
blocks.en: In validating a single-use filling system, a CDMO's practical work items include:

blocks.zh: 管路蠕動泵磨耗測試（>10 小時模擬運轉後取樣分析微粒）
blocks.en: Peristaltic pump tubing wear test (sample and analyze for particulates after >10 hours of simulated running)

blocks.zh: 充填針材質相容性確認（不鏽鋼 316L vs 聚合物充填針）
blocks.en: Material compatibility confirmation for filling needles (316L stainless steel vs polymer filling needles)

blocks.zh: Surge bag 對充填速率穩定性的影響評估
blocks.en: Assessment of the effect of the surge bag on filling rate stability

blocks.zh: 過濾器排氣程序無菌驗證（防止排氣期間外界汙染進入）
blocks.en: Aseptic validation of the filter venting procedure (to prevent outside contamination entering during venting)

blocks.zh: 你工廠的充填線組件是標準化還是客製化？更換供應商時需要重新進行哪些驗證項目？
blocks.en: Are the filling line assemblies at your plant standardized or custom? Which validation items must be repeated when you change supplier?

blocks.zh: Manifold 設計中如何避免死角？你現有的 SOP 對死角管理有什麼規定？
blocks.en: How are dead legs avoided in manifold design? What does your current SOP require for dead leg management?

blocks.zh: 2.1.3 Single-Use Systems（單次使用系統）
blocks.en: 2.1.3 Single-Use Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SUS 中的多次使用設備風險
blocks.en: Core Concept: Risks of Multi-Use Equipment in an SUS

blocks.zh: SUS 最容易被忽略的風險點：多次使用設備（Multi-Use Parts）對單次使用元件完整性的影響。
blocks.en: The risk most easily overlooked in an SUS: the effect of multi-use parts on the integrity of the single-use components.

blocks.zh: 蠕動泵的泵頭磨耗 → 管路受力變形 → 管壁變薄 → 爆破風險
blocks.en: Wear on the peristaltic pump head → tubing deforms under stress → wall thins → burst risk

blocks.zh: 不鏽鋼支撐框架的銳角或毛邊 → 袋體刮破 → 完整性失效
blocks.en: Sharp corners or burrs on the stainless steel support frame → bag is scratched or torn → loss of integrity

blocks.zh: 閥門驅動器的扭矩過大 → 管路受壓不均 → 洩漏
blocks.en: Excessive torque from a valve actuator → uneven pressure on the tubing → leakage

blocks.zh: 這意味著 SUS 的確效不只是測試一次性組件，更要確認多次使用設備在正常磨耗範圍內不影響組件完整性。
blocks.en: This means that validating an SUS is not only about testing the single-use assemblies; you must also confirm that the multi-use equipment, within its normal wear range, does not affect assembly integrity.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：SUS 確效的範疇界定
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Defining the Scope of SUS Validation

blocks.zh: 在制定 SUS 的 IQ/OQ/PQ 計畫時，需明確界定：
blocks.en: When drawing up the IQ/OQ/PQ plan for an SUS, you need to define clearly:

blocks.zh: 哪些部件是「單次使用組件」（每批更換，供應商負責 E&L 數據）
blocks.en: Which parts are "single-use assemblies" (replaced every batch; the supplier is responsible for the E&L data)

blocks.zh: 哪些部件是「多次使用設備」（需要設備確效，CDMO 自行維護）
blocks.en: Which parts are "multi-use equipment" (need equipment qualification; the CDMO maintains them)

blocks.zh: 兩者界面（Interface）的完整性測試頻率與方法
blocks.en: The frequency and method of integrity testing at the interface between the two

blocks.zh: 你工廠使用的生物反應器系統（如 Sartorius Biostat® 或 Thermo Fisher HyPerforma™）中，哪些是多次使用設備？這些設備的磨耗如何影響一次性袋體的完整性？
blocks.en: Which parts of the bioreactor systems at your plant (such as Sartorius Biostat® or Thermo Fisher HyPerforma™) are multi-use equipment? How does their wear affect the integrity of the single-use bags?

blocks.zh: 當多次使用設備送去保養維修時，回廠後需要進行哪些確效再確認步驟？
blocks.en: When multi-use equipment is sent out for maintenance or repair, which re-qualification steps are needed after it returns to the plant?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Extractables（可萃取物）——概論
blocks.en: 2.2 Extractables: Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Extractables vs Leachables——根本差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: Extractables vs Leachables, the Fundamental Difference

blocks.zh: 這是 SUT 最重要的概念區分，考試和法規審查中極常被混淆：
blocks.en: This is the most important conceptual distinction in SUT and is very often confused in exams and regulatory reviews:

blocks.zh: 可萃取物（Extractables, E）：在「誇張條件」下（高溫、極端 pH、有機溶劑）強制萃取出的化學物質。目的是建立材料的「化學指紋庫（Chemical Fingerprint）」，代表最大可能的化學風險。類似「刑事審訊」——逼出所有可能的化學物。
blocks.en: Extractables (E): chemical substances forcibly extracted under "exaggerated conditions" (high temperature, extreme pH, organic solvents). The aim is to build a "chemical fingerprint" library of the material, representing the maximum possible chemical risk. It is like a "criminal interrogation", forcing out every chemical that could possibly come out.

blocks.zh: 可瀝出物（Leachables, L）：在實際製程/產品條件下自然遷移出的化學物質，代表真實的患者暴露風險。類似「日常接觸」——真實環境下的實際釋出量。
blocks.en: Leachables (L): chemical substances that migrate out naturally under actual process/product conditions, representing the real patient exposure risk. It is like "everyday contact", the amount actually released in a real environment.

blocks.zh: 邏輯關係：Extractables ⊇ Leachables（可萃取物是可瀝出物的超集）。先做 E 研究，再用 E 的結果預測 L 的風險，決定是否需要進一步的 L 研究。
blocks.en: Logical relationship: Extractables ⊇ Leachables (extractables are a superset of leachables). Do the E study first, then use the E results to predict L risk and decide whether a further L study is needed.

blocks.zh: 風險評估的關鍵參數
blocks.en: Key Parameters for Risk Assessment

blocks.zh:
E&L 風險 ∝ 表面積/體積比 (SA/V) × 萃取潛力 × 接觸時間

高風險場景：小體積 + 大面積接觸（如充填管路）
低風險場景：大體積 + 短接觸時間（如轉移袋，接觸 ≤1 hr）

AET（Analytical Evaluation Threshold）計算：
AET = SCT × (重量/天用量) × (1/提取效率)
SCT = Safety Concern Threshold（ICH Q3D 或毒理 TTC 值）
blocks.en:
E&L risk ∝ surface area/volume ratio (SA/V) × extraction potential × contact time

High-risk scenario: small volume + large contact area (such as filling tubing)
Low-risk scenario: large volume + short contact time (such as a transfer bag, contact ≤1 hr)

AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold) calculation:
AET = SCT × (weight/daily dose) × (1/extraction efficiency)
SCT = Safety Concern Threshold (ICH Q3D or toxicological TTC value)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：E vs L 就像食品包裝測試
blocks.en: Analogy: E vs L Is Like Food Packaging Testing

blocks.zh: 想像一個塑膠水瓶：可萃取物研究就像把水瓶泡在熱水 + 酒精 + 酸液中強制萃取——測試最壞情況下會析出什麼物質；可瀝出物研究就像把水瓶裝水在常溫放 6 個月，再測水的成分——測試實際使用條件下你喝到了什麼。前者是安全底線研究，後者是現實風險確認。
blocks.en: Picture a plastic water bottle: an extractables study is like soaking the bottle in hot water + alcohol + acid to force extraction, testing what could come out in the worst case; a leachables study is like filling the bottle with water, leaving it at room temperature for 6 months and then testing the water, to see what you actually drink under real use conditions. The former is the safety baseline study; the latter confirms the real-world risk.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 作為中間製程的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Notes: What Is Special About a CDMO as an Intermediate Process

blocks.zh: 原文特別指出，本指引的 E&L 重點是製程接觸材料（PCM），而非最終劑型容器。這對 CDMO 很重要：
blocks.en: The original text points out that the E&L focus of this guide is on process contact materials (PCM) rather than final dosage form containers. This matters for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: CDMO 處理的是「藥物中間體（Drug Substance）」，不是直接接觸患者的最終產品
blocks.en: A CDMO handles "drug substance" intermediates, not the final product that contacts the patient directly

blocks.zh: 但某些製程步驟（如原液充填到 DS 儲存袋）的 E&L 數據可能被 MAH（上市許可持有人）要求納入法規申請
blocks.en: But for some process steps (such as filling drug substance into DS storage bags), the MAH (marketing authorization holder) may require the E&L data to be included in the regulatory submission

blocks.zh: 需明確在客戶合約中界定 E&L 數據的提供責任
blocks.en: Responsibility for providing E&L data must be clearly defined in the client contract

blocks.zh: 你工廠的哪個製程步驟具有最高的 SA/V 比？現有的 E&L 評估是否涵蓋了這個步驟的最壞條件？
blocks.en: Which process step at your plant has the highest SA/V ratio? Does the existing E&L assessment cover the worst-case conditions of that step?

blocks.zh: 當客戶提問「你們的一次性儲存袋有 E&L 數據嗎？」，你的標準回應流程是什麼？由誰提供哪些文件？
blocks.en: When a client asks "do your single-use storage bags have E&L data?", what is your standard response process? Who provides which documents?

blocks.zh: 2.2.1 Roles and Responsibilities（角色與責任分工）
blocks.en: 2.2.1 Roles and Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念：RACI 矩陣在 E&L 研究中的應用
blocks.en: Core Concept: Applying the RACI Matrix to E&L Studies

blocks.zh: RACI 矩陣（Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed）是跨組織協作的標準工具。在 E&L 研究中，端用者（End-User = CDMO/製藥公司）與供應商之間的責任劃分是最容易造成糾紛的環節。
blocks.en: The RACI matrix (Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed) is a standard tool for cross-organization collaboration. In E&L studies, the division of responsibility between the end user (CDMO/pharmaceutical company) and the supplier is the area most likely to cause disputes.

blocks.zh: 從表 2.1 可以看出幾個關鍵原則：
blocks.en: Table 2.1 shows several key principles:

blocks.zh: URS 定義：端用者主導（A/R），供應商只是 Informed——這意味著你必須先知道自己需要什麼，再要求供應商提供
blocks.en: URS definition: led by the end user (A/R), with the supplier only Informed. This means you must first know what you need and then ask the supplier to provide it

blocks.zh: 萃取程序執行：供應商主導（A/R），端用者全部是 Informed——供應商的實驗室能力是關鍵
blocks.en: Extraction procedure execution: led by the supplier (A/R), with all end users Informed. The supplier's laboratory capability is the key

blocks.zh: 毒理評估：端用者 Quality/Regulatory 是 R，SME 是 A——毒理結論的責任在用戶端
blocks.en: Toxicological assessment: end-user Quality/Regulatory is R and the SME is A. Responsibility for the toxicological conclusion sits with the user

blocks.zh: 重點提示：SME（Subject Matter Expert）的角色
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Role of the SME (Subject Matter Expert)

blocks.zh: E&L 研究需要的跨領域專業：
blocks.en: Cross-disciplinary expertise needed for E&L studies:

blocks.zh: 分析化學：GC-MS、LC-MS、ICP-MS 方法開發與驗證
blocks.en: Analytical chemistry: development and validation of GC-MS, LC-MS and ICP-MS methods

blocks.zh: 毒理學：TTC（Threshold of Toxicological Concern）評估、ICH Q3D 元素雜質風險評分
blocks.en: Toxicology: TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern) assessment and ICH Q3D elemental impurity risk scoring

blocks.zh: 聚合物科學：了解特定聚合物的已知降解產物（例如矽膠的環狀矽氧烷 D4、D5）
blocks.en: Polymer science: knowledge of the known degradation products of specific polymers (for example the cyclic siloxanes D4 and D5 from silicone)

blocks.zh: 法規事務：ICH Q3D、USP <661>、EP 3.1、FDA/EMA E&L 指引的要求對照
blocks.en: Regulatory affairs: cross-referencing the requirements of ICH Q3D, USP <661>, EP 3.1 and FDA/EMA E&L guidance

blocks.zh: 對於不具備完整 SME 能力的 CDMO，通常需要委外給專業的毒理 CRO 進行評估。
blocks.en: A CDMO without full SME capability will usually need to outsource the assessment to a specialist toxicology CRO.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：供應商審核中的 E&L 問卷
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: E&L Questionnaire in Supplier Audits

blocks.zh: 在供應商資格審核（Supplier Qualification）時，應要求提供：
blocks.en: In supplier qualification, require the supplier to provide:

blocks.zh: E&L 研究報告摘要（是否涵蓋目標應用的萃取條件）
blocks.en: A summary of the E&L study report (does it cover the extraction conditions of the intended application?)

blocks.zh: 使用的分析方法與偵測極限（LOD/LOQ）
blocks.en: The analytical methods used and their detection limits (LOD/LOQ)

blocks.zh: 是否已通過 AET 評估，並提供毒理評估結論
blocks.en: Whether an AET assessment has been done, with the toxicological assessment conclusion

blocks.zh: 批次間變異性數據（至少 3 批）
blocks.en: Lot-to-lot variability data (at least 3 lots)

blocks.zh: 伽馬輻照後的 E&L 數據是否包含在報告中
blocks.en: Whether E&L data after gamma irradiation are included in the report

blocks.zh: 你工廠現在的 SUT 供應商審核流程中，有無要求 E&L 數據包？如果沒有，從哪個步驟開始補充最有效率？
blocks.en: Does your plant's current SUT supplier audit process require an E&L data package? If not, at which step would it be most efficient to add it?

blocks.zh: 毒理評估（Toxicological Assessment）在你的組織由誰負責？是內部 QA/RA 還是委外 CRO？各有什麼限制？
blocks.en: Who is responsible for the toxicological assessment in your organization: internal QA/RA or an outsourced CRO? What are the limitations of each?

blocks.zh: 2.2.2 Pre-requirements（前提要求）
blocks.en: 2.2.2 Pre-requirements

blocks.zh: 核心概念：E&L 研究的門檻前提
blocks.en: Core Concept: Prerequisites for an E&L Study

blocks.zh: 進行正式 E&L 研究之前，材料必須先通過這些「基礎資格審查」——就像應聘工作需先有基本學歷門檻才能進入面試環節。
blocks.en: Before a formal E&L study, the material must first pass these "basic qualification checks", like a job applicant who needs to meet the minimum education requirement before reaching the interview stage.

blocks.zh: 最關鍵的禁用成分：
blocks.en: The most critical prohibited ingredients:

blocks.zh: 天然橡膠/乳膠：過敏原，注射用藥品絕對禁用
blocks.en: Natural rubber/latex: an allergen, absolutely prohibited for injectable drug products

blocks.zh: 多環芳烴 (PAH)：致癌物，來源通常是碳黑或礦物油潤滑劑
blocks.en: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH): carcinogens, usually originating from carbon black or mineral oil lubricants

blocks.zh: N-亞硝胺 (N-Nitrosamines)：ICH M7 基因毒性雜質，極低 TTC（1.5 μg/天）
blocks.en: N-Nitrosamines: genotoxic impurities under ICH M7, with a very low TTC (1.5 μg/day)

blocks.zh: MBT（苯並噻唑）：橡膠硫化促進劑，潛在致癌物
blocks.en: MBT (mercaptobenzothiazole): a rubber vulcanization accelerator and potential carcinogen

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：供應商 CoA 審查要點
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Key Points of Supplier CoA Review

blocks.zh: 收到新批次一次性組件時，在 CoA 審查中確認：
blocks.en: When a new lot of single-use assemblies arrives, confirm the following in the CoA review:

blocks.zh: 材料聲明（Material Declaration）：有無聲明不含乳膠/PAH/N-亞硝胺/MBT
blocks.en: Material declaration: does it state that the material is free of latex/PAH/N-nitrosamines/MBT?

blocks.zh: USP <87>/<88> 測試結果（合格/Passes）
blocks.en: USP <87>/<88> test results (passes)

blocks.zh: EP 3.1 或等效聲明
blocks.en: EP 3.1 or an equivalent declaration

blocks.zh: 動物源性原料聲明（如含硬脂酸鹽，需符合 97/534/EC）
blocks.en: Declaration for animal-derived raw materials (for example, if stearates are present, compliance with 97/534/EC is required)

blocks.zh: 2.2.3 Risk Assessment in Extractables Study（可萃取物研究的風險評估）
blocks.en: 2.2.3 Risk Assessment in Extractables Study

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICH Q9 風險管理在 E&L 研究的應用
blocks.en: Core Concept: Applying ICH Q9 Risk Management to E&L Studies

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 的核心工具（FMEA、HACCP、風險矩陣）在 E&L 研究中的具體應用：
blocks.en: Specific applications of the core ICH Q9 tools (FMEA, HACCP, risk matrix) in E&L studies:

blocks.zh: 自動化製造 vs 手工製造：自動化製程批次間變異小，可能允許減少批次數；手工製程變異大，需要更多批次樣本覆蓋
blocks.en: Automated vs manual manufacturing: automated processes have low lot-to-lot variation and may allow fewer lots; manual processes vary more and need more lots to cover the variability

blocks.zh: 化學指紋庫（Chemical Fingerprint）：E&L 研究的最終目標——建立每個一次性元件的「身份 DNA」，包含所有潛在遷移物的定性定量數據
blocks.en: Chemical fingerprint: the ultimate goal of an E&L study is to build an "identity DNA" for each single-use component, containing qualitative and quantitative data on all potential migrants

blocks.zh: 重點提示：雙重責任視角
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Dual Responsibility View

blocks.zh: 原文強調供應商和端用者各有責任：
blocks.en: The original text stresses that the supplier and the end user each have responsibilities:

blocks.zh: 供應商責任：在元件開發階段就考慮患者安全，選擇低遷移性聚合物，提供完整的 E&L 數據包
blocks.en: Supplier responsibility: consider patient safety from the component development stage, choose low-migration polymers and provide a complete E&L data package

blocks.zh: 端用者責任（CDMO）：在將元件導入製程時進行風險評估，確認供應商的 E&L 數據適用於自身的製程條件（溫度、pH、接觸時間可能與供應商的標準測試條件不同）
blocks.en: End-user (CDMO) responsibility: when introducing a component into the process, perform a risk assessment and confirm that the supplier's E&L data apply to your own process conditions (temperature, pH and contact time may differ from the supplier's standard test conditions)

blocks.zh: 這是最常見的風險盲區——供應商的標準萃取條件未必涵蓋 CDMO 客戶的特定製程條件。
blocks.en: This is the most common blind spot: the supplier's standard extraction conditions do not necessarily cover the specific process conditions of the CDMO's clients.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：E&L 風險評估矩陣建立
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Building an E&L Risk Assessment Matrix

blocks.zh: 建議依以下維度建立 E&L 風險矩陣：
blocks.en: We recommend building the E&L risk matrix along these dimensions:

blocks.zh: 接觸時間：<1 hr（低）/ 1–24 hr（中）/ >24 hr（高）
blocks.en: Contact time: <1 hr (low) / 1–24 hr (medium) / >24 hr (high)

blocks.zh: 接觸面積：SA/V 比 <1 cm⁻¹（低）/ 1–10 cm⁻¹（中）/ >10 cm⁻¹（高）
blocks.en: Contact area: SA/V ratio <1 cm⁻¹ (low) / 1–10 cm⁻¹ (medium) / >10 cm⁻¹ (high)

blocks.zh: 製程位置：上游（低）/ 下游（中）/ 充填前（高）
blocks.en: Process position: upstream (low) / downstream (medium) / pre-filling (high)

blocks.zh: 溫度：室溫（低）/ 37°C 培養（中）/ >50°C（高）
blocks.en: Temperature: room temperature (low) / 37°C culture (medium) / >50°C (high)

blocks.zh: 矩陣評分決定需要的 E&L 研究深度（供應商數據即可 / 需要補充研究 / 需要完整自主研究）。
blocks.en: The matrix score determines the depth of E&L study needed (supplier data are sufficient / supplementary study needed / full in-house study needed).

blocks.zh: 2.2.4 Design Space（設計空間）
blocks.en: 2.2.4 Design Space

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QbD + DOE 在 E&L 研究中的應用
blocks.en: Core Concept: Applying QbD + DOE to E&L Studies

blocks.zh: ICH Q8 的 QbD 精神應用到 E&L 研究：
blocks.en: Applying the QbD approach of ICH Q8 to E&L studies:

blocks.zh: 關鍵品質屬性（CQA）：哪些可萃取化合物對患者安全有影響？（毒理篩選確定）
blocks.en: Critical Quality Attributes (CQA): which extractable compounds affect patient safety? (determined by toxicological screening)

blocks.zh: 關鍵製程參數（CPP）：溫度、pH、接觸時間、SA/V 比這些參數如何影響萃取量？
blocks.en: Critical Process Parameters (CPP): how do temperature, pH, contact time and SA/V ratio affect the amount extracted?

blocks.zh: 設計空間（Design Space）：在哪些參數範圍內，可萃取物濃度始終低於 AET？
blocks.en: Design Space: within which parameter ranges does the extractable concentration always stay below the AET?

blocks.zh: DOE 設計：系統性地改變萃取條件（例如 2×2 因子設計：低溫/高溫 × 低 pH/高 pH），找到最壞條件組合
blocks.en: DOE design: systematically vary the extraction conditions (for example a 2×2 factorial design: low/high temperature × low/high pH) to find the worst-case combination

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念：CCS / PPC / PCM 的層級關係
blocks.en: Key Concept: The CCS / PPC / PCM Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 這三個縮寫在法規文件中頻繁出現，必須清楚區分：
blocks.en: These three abbreviations appear frequently in regulatory documents and must be clearly distinguished:

blocks.zh: CCS（容器密封系統）：最廣義——整個容器+密封系統，是 ICH Q1B、ICH Q3B 研究的對象
blocks.en: CCS (container closure system): the broadest term, meaning the whole container + closure system, the subject of ICH Q1B and ICH Q3B studies

blocks.zh: PPC（初級包裝元件）：直接接觸最終藥品的包裝材料（如西林瓶、膠塞、鋁蓋）
blocks.en: PPC (primary packaging component): packaging material in direct contact with the final drug product (such as vials, rubber stoppers and aluminum caps)

blocks.zh: PCM（製程接觸材料）：製程中接觸中間體的材料（SUT 的主要研究對象）
blocks.en: PCM (process contact material): material that contacts the intermediate during processing (the main subject of SUT studies)

blocks.zh:
在生物製劑 CDMO 中：
PCM = 一次性袋體、管路（DS 製造階段）
PPC = 西林瓶、膠塞（DP 充填後）
CCS = 西林瓶 + 膠塞 + 鋁蓋整體系統
blocks.en:
In a biologics CDMO:
PCM = single-use bags and tubing (DS manufacturing stage)
PPC = vials and stoppers (after DP filling)
CCS = the vial + stopper + aluminum cap as a whole system

blocks.zh: 臨界應用分層邏輯
blocks.en: Logic of Tiering by Critical Application

blocks.zh:
製程位置對 E&L 風險的影響：

上游（細胞培養/發酵）
  ↓ 多道純化步驟可去除遷移物
  ↓ 離子交換層析、病毒過濾、超濾
  ↓
下游（純化後原液）
  ↓ 僅剩一道除菌過濾
  ↓
充填/封裝（Fill/Finish）← 最高風險
  ↓ 無後續去除機制
  ↓ 直接進入最終產品

原則：距充填越近 → E&L 要求越嚴格
blocks.en:
Effect of process position on E&L risk:

Upstream (cell culture/fermentation)
  ↓ multiple purification steps can remove migrants
  ↓ ion exchange chromatography, virus filtration, ultrafiltration
  ↓
Downstream (purified drug substance)
  ↓ only one sterilizing filtration left
  ↓
Filling/finishing (Fill/Finish) ← highest risk
  ↓ no later removal mechanism
  ↓ goes directly into the final product

Principle: the closer to filling, the stricter the E&L requirements

blocks.zh: 重點提示：從供應商數據到端用者計算
blocks.en: Key Notes: From Supplier Data to End-User Calculation

blocks.zh: 供應商的 E&L 數據通常以「每單位面積萃取量（μg/cm²）」表示。端用者（CDMO）需要將其換算成實際製程暴露量：
blocks.en: Supplier E&L data are usually expressed as "amount extracted per unit area (μg/cm²)". The end user (CDMO) must convert them into the actual process exposure:

blocks.zh: 實際暴露量（μg/L）= 供應商數據（μg/cm²）× 實際 SA（cm²）÷ 批次體積（L）
blocks.en: Actual exposure (μg/L) = supplier data (μg/cm²) × actual SA (cm²) ÷ batch volume (L)

blocks.zh: 再與 AET 比較，決定是否需要額外的特定目標研究（Targeted Study）。
blocks.en: Then compare with the AET to decide whether an additional targeted study is needed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：決策樹的實務執行
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Practical Execution of the Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 當 E&L 評估結論出現以下情況時的標準處理路徑：
blocks.en: Standard handling paths when the E&L assessment reaches the following conclusions:

blocks.zh: 計算暴露量 < AET：記錄評估結論，無需額外測試，定期審查
blocks.en: Calculated exposure < AET: document the assessment conclusion; no additional testing needed; review periodically

blocks.zh: 計算暴露量 > AET 但有毒理數據支持：進行完整毒理評估，記錄風險接受理由
blocks.en: Calculated exposure > AET but supported by toxicological data: perform a full toxicological assessment and document the rationale for risk acceptance

blocks.zh: 計算暴露量 > AET 且無充分毒理數據：考慮更換供應商、更換元件材質、或補充特定目標 E&L 研究
blocks.en: Calculated exposure > AET with insufficient toxicological data: consider changing supplier, changing the component material, or adding a targeted E&L study

blocks.zh: 存在已知基因毒性化合物：即使低於一般 AET，需符合 ICH M7 規定（TTC 1.5 μg/天）
blocks.en: Known genotoxic compound present: even if below the general AET, ICH M7 must be met (TTC 1.5 μg/day)

blocks.zh: 2.2.5 Key Recommendations for Extractables Study（可萃取物研究的關鍵建議）
blocks.en: 2.2.5 Key Recommendations for Extractables Study

blocks.zh: 核心概念：化學指紋庫（Chemical Fingerprint）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Chemical Fingerprint

blocks.zh: E&L 研究的最終交付物是一份「化學指紋庫」，包含：
blocks.en: The final deliverable of an E&L study is a "chemical fingerprint" library containing:

blocks.zh: 已鑑定化合物的清單（定性——GC-MS、LC-MS 鑑定）
blocks.en: A list of identified compounds (qualitative: identified by GC-MS, LC-MS)

blocks.zh: 各化合物的濃度（定量——與 AET 比較）
blocks.en: The concentration of each compound (quantitative: compared with the AET)

blocks.zh: 毒理評估結論（是否需要進一步關注）
blocks.en: The toxicological assessment conclusion (whether further attention is needed)

blocks.zh: 這份指紋庫具有材料特異性——換了供應商、換了批次樹脂、改了製造製程，都需要重新評估指紋庫是否仍然適用。
blocks.en: This fingerprint library is material-specific: if the supplier changes, the resin lot changes or the manufacturing process changes, you must reassess whether the fingerprint library still applies.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：滅菌條件對 E&L 的影響
blocks.en: Core Concept: Effect of Sterilization Conditions on E&L

blocks.zh: 2.2.5.1 特別強調元件在萃取測試前應已完成與實際使用相同的處理程序，其中滅菌最關鍵：
blocks.en: 2.2.5.1 stresses that components should already have gone through the same treatments as in actual use before extraction testing, and sterilization is the most critical:

blocks.zh: 伽馬輻照（Gamma Irradiation）：輻射能量引發聚合物鏈斷裂和自由基反應，可能產生新的分解產物（如矽膠中的低分子量環狀矽氧烷 D4/D5）
blocks.en: Gamma irradiation: radiation energy causes polymer chain scission and free-radical reactions, which may generate new degradation products (such as the low-molecular-weight cyclic siloxanes D4/D5 in silicone)

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸汽滅菌（Autoclave）：高溫高濕可能加速水解，從聚合物中析出添加劑
blocks.en: Autoclave: high temperature and humidity may accelerate hydrolysis and release additives from the polymer

blocks.zh: 環氧乙烷（EtO）：EtO 殘留及其反應產物（乙二醇、乙烯氯醇）需要納入 E&L 評估
blocks.en: Ethylene oxide (EtO): EtO residues and their reaction products (ethylene glycol, ethylene chlorohydrin) need to be included in the E&L assessment

blocks.zh: 重點提示：近端包裝材料（Proximal Packaging）的風險
blocks.en: Key Notes: Risk from Proximal Packaging

blocks.zh: 這個常被忽略的風險點：外包裝（紙箱、標籤、黏著劑、油墨）中的化學物質可能穿透玻璃轉化溫度低於室溫的聚合物容器，最終遷移至內容物。常見的高風險化合物：
blocks.en: A frequently overlooked risk: chemicals in the outer packaging (cartons, labels, adhesives, inks) may permeate polymer containers whose glass transition temperature is below room temperature and eventually migrate into the contents. Common high-risk compounds:

blocks.zh: 印刷油墨中的光起始劑（Photoinitiators）：如 ITX（isopropylthioxanthone）——著名的 Isociate 污染事件
blocks.en: Photoinitiators in printing inks: such as ITX (isopropylthioxanthone), as in the well-known "Isociate" contamination incident

blocks.zh: 黏著劑溶劑：甲苯、乙酸乙酯的殘留
blocks.en: Adhesive solvents: residual toluene and ethyl acetate

blocks.zh: 紙板中的礦物油：MOH（Mineral Oil Hydrocarbons）污染
blocks.en: Mineral oil in paperboard: MOH (Mineral Oil Hydrocarbons) contamination

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：滅菌改變 E&L 就像烹飪改變食物
blocks.en: Analogy: Sterilization Changes E&L Like Cooking Changes Food

blocks.zh: 未烹飪的生雞肉（未滅菌元件）和烤雞（伽馬輻照後元件）的化學成分截然不同。你不能用生雞肉的「食品安全分析」來代表烤雞的安全性。同樣地，供應商的 E&L 數據必須明確標示是輻照前還是輻照後的數據，兩者不可互換。
blocks.en: Raw chicken (an unsterilized component) and roast chicken (a component after gamma irradiation) have quite different chemical compositions. You cannot use a "food safety analysis" of raw chicken to represent the safety of roast chicken. Likewise, supplier E&L data must state clearly whether they were generated before or after irradiation, and the two cannot be interchanged.

blocks.zh: 你現有的 SUT 供應商提供的 E&L 數據是在伽馬輻照前還是後測試的？輻照劑量是否與你廠接收規格一致？
blocks.en: Were the E&L data from your current SUT suppliers generated before or after gamma irradiation? Is the irradiation dose consistent with your site's receiving specification?

blocks.zh: 你的一次性儲存袋外層包裝有無使用含有機溶劑的油墨？玻璃化轉變溫度是多少？有無進行過近端包裝的遷移評估？
blocks.en: Does the outer packaging of your single-use storage bags use inks containing organic solvents? What is the glass transition temperature? Has a migration assessment of proximal packaging been done?

blocks.zh: 2.2.6 Extractables Testing（可萃取物測試）
blocks.en: 2.2.6 Extractables Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：批次選擇的科學依據
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Scientific Basis for Lot Selection

blocks.zh: 「非連續批次（Non-Consecutive Lots）」的設計邏輯：想要捕捉的是供應商的製程變異（樹脂批次、製造時間、滅菌參數），而非同一大批次的分割。
blocks.en: The design logic behind "non-consecutive lots": the aim is to capture the supplier's process variation (resin lot, manufacturing time, sterilization parameters), not subdivisions of the same large lot.

blocks.zh: 常見陷阱：採購了 3 批一次性袋，但其實是同一批樹脂在同一週內生產的——這 3 批並不代表真正的批次間變異。正確做法：要求供應商提供不同樹脂批號的產品。
blocks.en: A common pitfall: you buy 3 lots of single-use bags, but they are all made from the same resin lot within the same week, so these 3 lots do not represent true lot-to-lot variation. The correct approach is to ask the supplier for products made from different resin lot numbers.

blocks.zh: AET（分析評估閾值）計算
blocks.en: AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold) Calculation

blocks.zh:
AET 定義：低於此濃度的萃取物無需進一步毒理關注

計算公式（簡化）：
AET = SCT ÷ (日劑量體積 × 萃取效率)

其中：
SCT = Safety Concern Threshold
  - 一般有機物 TTC = 1.5 μg/天（Kroes et al.）
  - ICH Q3D 元素雜質：依元素毒性分類（PDE 值）
  - 基因毒性化合物（ICH M7）= 1.5 μg/天

示例：
日劑量體積 = 100 mL
SCT = 150 μg/天（一般有機物上調係數後）
萃取效率 = 50%
AET = 150 ÷ (0.1 L × 0.5) = 3,000 μg/L = 3 ppm
blocks.en:
AET definition: extractables below this concentration need no further toxicological attention

Calculation formula (simplified):
AET = SCT ÷ (daily dose volume × extraction efficiency)

Where:
SCT = Safety Concern Threshold
  - General organic compounds TTC = 1.5 μg/day (Kroes et al.)
  - ICH Q3D elemental impurities: by elemental toxicity class (PDE values)
  - Genotoxic compounds (ICH M7) = 1.5 μg/day

Example:
Daily dose volume = 100 mL
SCT = 150 μg/day (after the adjustment factor for general organic compounds)
Extraction efficiency = 50%
AET = 150 ÷ (0.1 L × 0.5) = 3,000 μg/L = 3 ppm

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：Ishikawa（魚骨圖）在 E&L 研究設計
blocks.en: Analogy: The Ishikawa (Fishbone) Diagram in E&L Study Design

blocks.zh: 用魚骨圖分析影響萃取結果的因素，就像調查事故根因：主幹是「萃取物濃度」，六根骨頭分別是「溫度」、「pH」、「接觸時間」、「SA/V 比」、「溶劑種類」、「元件特性」。系統性地評估每根骨頭，才能設計出覆蓋所有最壞條件的 DOE 實驗方案。
blocks.en: Use a fishbone diagram to analyze the factors that affect extraction results, like investigating the root cause of an incident: the main spine is "extractable concentration", and the six bones are "temperature", "pH", "contact time", "SA/V ratio", "solvent type" and "component characteristics". Only by assessing each bone systematically can you design a DOE plan that covers all worst-case conditions.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用場景：接受供應商 E&L 數據的確認清單
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Checklist for Accepting Supplier E&L Data

blocks.zh: 當供應商提交 E&L 報告時，CDMO QA 應確認：
blocks.en: When a supplier submits an E&L report, CDMO QA should confirm:

blocks.zh: 測試批次是否使用了非連續批號（≥3 批）
blocks.en: Were non-consecutive lot numbers used for the test lots (≥3 lots)?

blocks.zh: 萃取條件是否涵蓋你的製程最壞條件（最高溫度、最長接觸時間、最大 SA/V）
blocks.en: Do the extraction conditions cover your process worst case (highest temperature, longest contact time, largest SA/V)?

blocks.zh: 報告中的 AET 計算是否基於你的產品每日劑量（Different products = different AETs！）
blocks.en: Is the AET calculation in the report based on your product's daily dose? (Different products = different AETs!)

blocks.zh: GC-MS、LC-MS、ICP-MS 三項分析是否都已執行？LOQ 是否低於 AET 的 1/5？
blocks.en: Have all three analyses, GC-MS, LC-MS and ICP-MS, been performed? Is the LOQ below 1/5 of the AET?

blocks.zh: 所有鑑定化合物是否都有毒理結論（通過/需關注/需進一步測試）？
blocks.en: Does every identified compound have a toxicological conclusion (pass / needs attention / needs further testing)?

blocks.zh: 如有超出 AET 的化合物，是否提供了完整的毒理評估（HHE）？
blocks.en: For any compound exceeding the AET, has a full toxicological assessment (HHE) been provided?

blocks.zh: 你工廠目前使用的一次性儲存袋供應商，是否提供了包含 GC-MS + LC-MS + ICP-MS 三種分析的完整 E&L 報告？報告中的萃取條件是否覆蓋了你的最高儲存溫度？
blocks.en: Does the supplier of the single-use storage bags your plant currently uses provide a complete E&L report that includes all three analyses (GC-MS + LC-MS + ICP-MS)? Do the extraction conditions in the report cover your highest storage temperature?

blocks.zh: 如果要為新引進的 mAb 原液儲存袋計算 AET，你需要哪些輸入數據？你的毒理評估流程是什麼？由誰負責最終結論？
blocks.en: If you need to calculate the AET for a newly introduced mAb drug substance storage bag, what input data do you need? What is your toxicological assessment process? Who is responsible for the final conclusion?

blocks.zh: 關鍵概念：模擬溶劑（Model Solvents）的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Logic for Selecting Model Solvents

blocks.zh: 模擬溶劑的選擇依據極性梯度，覆蓋不同類型的化學遷移物：
blocks.en: Model solvents are selected along a polarity gradient so as to cover different types of chemical migrants:

blocks.zh: ISPE 的建議：使用表面積（而非質量）來決定萃取溶劑體積，確保 SA/V 比的一致性。
blocks.en: ISPE recommendation: use surface area (not mass) to determine the extraction solvent volume, to keep the SA/V ratio consistent.

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 三層架構：單次使用技術分為元件（Component）→ 組件（Assembly）→ 系統（SUS）三個層次。浸濕元件是 E&L 研究的主要對象，非浸濕元件也需進行間接影響評估。
blocks.en: Three-level structure: single-use technology is divided into three levels: component → assembly → system (SUS). Wetted components are the main subject of E&L studies, and non-wetted components also need an assessment of indirect effects.

blocks.zh: 元件多樣性：生物工藝袋（2-D/3-D）、管路（矽膠/氟聚合物/熱塑性）、無菌連接器（有性別/無性別）、過濾器（除菌/深層/切向流）、感測器（單次/多次）等元件各有其設計特點與限制，選型需考量製程相容性和 E&L 數據完整性。
blocks.en: Component diversity: bioprocess bags (2-D/3-D), tubing (silicone/fluoropolymer/thermoplastic), aseptic connectors (gendered/genderless), filters (sterilizing/depth/tangential flow), sensors (single-use/multi-use) and other components each have their own design features and limitations; selection must consider process compatibility and the completeness of E&L data.

blocks.zh: E vs L 根本差異：可萃取物（Extractables）用「誇張條件」強制萃取，代表最大化學風險上限；可瀝出物（Leachables）用實際製程條件，代表真實患者暴露量。前者先行，後者依需要補充。
blocks.en: Fundamental difference between E and L: Extractables use "exaggerated conditions" for forced extraction and represent the upper bound of chemical risk; Leachables use actual process conditions and represent real patient exposure. The former comes first, and the latter is added as needed.

blocks.zh: 風險分層原則：製程位置越靠近充填步驟，E&L 要求越嚴格——因為稀釋和過濾等風險緩解機制越少。充填組件屬最高風險等級，需最完整的 E&L 評估。
blocks.en: Risk tiering principle: the closer the process position is to the filling step, the stricter the E&L requirements, because there are fewer risk mitigation mechanisms such as dilution and filtration. The filling assembly is in the highest risk class and needs the most complete E&L assessment.

blocks.zh: 分析三劍客：GC-MS（揮發性有機物）、LC-MS（非揮發性極性有機物）、ICP-MS（元素雜質）三項分析技術聯合使用，才能覆蓋完整的化學指紋庫。AET 是判斷是否需要進一步毒理關注的關鍵閾值。
blocks.en: The analytical trio: GC-MS (volatile organics), LC-MS (non-volatile polar organics) and ICP-MS (elemental impurities) must be used together to cover the full chemical fingerprint. The AET is the key threshold for judging whether further toxicological attention is needed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的雙重責任：作為端用者，CDMO 必須建立明確的供應商 E&L 數據審查流程（RACI），確認供應商的萃取條件與自身製程最壞條件的相關性，並對毒理評估結論承擔最終責任。
blocks.en: The CDMO's dual responsibility: as the end user, the CDMO must set up a clear process (RACI) for reviewing supplier E&L data, confirm that the supplier's extraction conditions are relevant to the worst case of its own process, and bear final responsibility for the toxicological assessment conclusion.
